blocks.text: TOKYO, Japan — A 78-year-old man in southwestern Japan who told police he could not afford funeral expenses for his younger brother has been arrested on suspicion of abandoning a body at his home. Hisao Takaki, an unemployed resident of Kumamoto, was arrested Tuesday. Police are working to identify the body, which was found covered with bedding and partially reduced to skeletal remains. The man’s brother died around February.
